text:
Maya: Hey folks — need to swap my Sun 18:00–Mon 06:00 oncall. Kid's school concert conflict. Who can cover or split?
Tom: I can take 18:00–00:00. @Maya, any warmup steps you want me to run?
Maya: Thanks @Tom. Minimal warmup list below — mostly cache prefill + quick health checks.
Maya: ```bash
# prefill prefix cache for primary model
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/prefill -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","prompts":["hi","summarize: 2 sentences","translate en->es"],"ttl":3600}'
# verify serving runtime pods
kubectl get pods -l app=serving-runtime -o wide
```
Lia: FYI there is a short maintenance window Sunday 02:00–02:30 UTC in us-west; autoscaling will be limited. Expect brief reduced burst capacity.
oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance at 2024-11-10T02:00Z. Autoscaling burst capacity reduced by 25% for 30m.
Ryan: I can pick up 00:00–06:00. Also recommend warming the embedding/reranker cache while doing prefix prefill.
Maya: Great — split plan: Tom 18:00–00:00, Ryan 00:00–06:00. I'll transfer the pager now and drop a short handoff note in the ticket.
Maya: Handoff notes (quick):
- Alerts: cpu>85% for 5m -> P2
- Known flake: liveliness check on node fs-3 (ignore warnings unless service-level errors)
- Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall-core.md
Tom: Quick checklist I ran/you should run: 1) `kubectl rollout status deploy/serving-runtime` 2) curl https://prod-serving/healthz 3) run the prefill curl command above and confirm 200s
Ryan: For rerankers use short prompt set: "hi", "summarize: 2 sentences", "translate en->es" — mirrors common traffic and warms embedding cache.
Maya: Pushed the handoff ticket: INC-4712, added these notes. Swapping pager now — oncall transfer done at 1719001610.
Tom: Received pager. I'll do a quick validation at 18:05 and post results here.
Ryan: I'll DM Maya if I need clarification and leave notes in INC-4712 before my shift.
Maya: Logs to check if anything weird: `journalctl -u runtime -n 500` and grep for "KV cache OOM" or "prefill error".
Lia: Thanks team! Also ping oncall if latency > 350ms p95 — escalate to eng-sre.
oncall-bot: oncall assignment updated: Tom (18:00–00:00), Ryan (00:00–06:00).
Tom: Confirmed, closing the loop.
Maya: Thanks everyone :heart: — really appreciate the cover.
